hook: Mark Zuckerberg launched Facebook with Harvard roommates in February 2004 and has led the company since, taking it public in 2012 and renaming it Meta in October 2021. He has argued publicly for open-source AI, and Meta has released its Llama models under open weights, including Llama 3.1 405B in 2024 and Llama 4 in 2025. In mid-2025 he formed Meta Superintelligence Labs and wrote that Meta's aim is personal superintelligence for everyone.

quick_facts: Born in White Plains, New York, in 1984, he studied computer science and psychology at Harvard before leaving in his second year to build Facebook.
Facebook launched on February 4, 2004, and went public in May 2012.
The company took the name Meta on October 28, 2021, when he introduced the new brand at its Connect conference.
On July 23, 2024, he published Open Source AI Is the Path Forward alongside the release of Llama 3.1 405B, and Meta released Llama 4 Scout and Maverick on April 5, 2025.
He announced Meta Superintelligence Labs on June 30, 2025, naming Alexandr Wang chief AI officer, according to reporting cited by Wikipedia.
He co-founded the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative with Priscilla Chan in 2015 and serves as its co-CEO.
